paragraphs.source_en: But when an elaborate and minute division of labor has set in, this direct and immediate connection ceases to exist.I do not make all the things I consume but, perhaps, only one of them. With the income J derive from making this one commodity, or rendering this one service, I buy all the rest. I wish the price of everything I buy to be low,but it is in my interest for the price of the commodity or services that I have to sell to be high. Therefore, though I wish to see abundance in everything else, it is In my interest for scarcity to exist in the very thing that it is my business to supply. The greater the scarcity, compared to everything else, in this one thing that I supply, the higher will be the reward that I can get for my efforts.

paragraphs.source_en: Ordinarily these selfish feelings would have no effect on the total production of wheat. Wherever competition ex-ists, in fact, each producer is compelled to put forth his utmost efforts to raise the highest possible crop on his own land. In this way the forces of self-interest (which,for good or evil, are more persistently powerful than those of altruism) are harnessed to maximum output.
